description_en: Uploads an existing certificate signing request (CSR) to Certificate Management Service. After the upload, you can use the CSR to apply for certificates
description_zh: 阿里云数字证书管理服务支持上传已有的CSR，以便申请证书时使用，同时也可对上传的CSR进行统一管理
name: UploadCsr

parameters.help_en: The name of the CSR. The name can be up to 50 characters long and can contain uppercase letters (A–Z), lowercase letters (a–z), digits (0–9), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: CSR名称。支持使用英文大小写字母（a~z和A~Z）、阿拉伯数字（0~9）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）。长度不超过50个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.example: -----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY----- MII.... -----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
parameters.help_en: The content of the certificate's private key in PEM format
parameters.name: key

CsrId.description_en: The unique ID of the CSR. You can use this ID to obtain the content of the CSR. For more information, see [GetCsrDetail]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2709720.html）
CsrId.description_zh: CSR唯一标识。后续可通过该值直接获取CSR内容。获取CSR的接口请参见[GetCsrDetail]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2709720.html）
